hero_title: Dedicated to advancing women protection, accessible healthcare and WASH initiatives across Nigerian communities.
hero_subtitle: We believe that access to basic healthcare, basic education, basic women's representation, and clean water is a fundamental human right. Our mission is to bridge the gap and deliver sustainable solutions to those who need them most.
story_paragraphs: Ronnie Care Foundation was born out of a profound need to address the systemic disparities in healthcare and sanitation access within underserved regions. What began as a localized effort to provide essential medical supplies has rapidly evolved into a comprehensive network of care, reaching numerous communities.

Our journey has been defined by collaborative partnerships with local leaders, international health organizations, education policymakers, and a dedicated team of medical professionals. Together, we are building resilient health infrastructure and sustainable education framework/toolkit and pioneering sustainable Water, Sanitation, and Hygiene (WASH) programs that save lives and foster long-term community well-being.
vision: To create a future where equitable access to quality healthcare and clean water is universally guaranteed, empowering communities to thrive and reach their full potential without the burden of preventable diseases.
mission: To design and implement innovative, sustainable healthcare and WASH interventions. We strive to strengthen local health systems, provide immediate relief, and deliver continuous education to foster resilient, self-sufficient communities.

leadership_team.name: Dr. Adegboye Taiwo Aderonke
leadership_team.title: Executive Director/Founder
leadership_team.bio: A young and vibrant entrepreneur. She is the CEO of Ronnie Diagnostic Center. Aderonke is an experienced research analyst who has worked as a monitoring and evaluation manager for both international and national non-governmental organizations.

leadership_team.name: Pharm. Ogunkunle Jeremiah
leadership_team.title: Director of Operations
leadership_team.bio: A powerful team player with excellent interpersonal, organizational, and time management skills. He graduated from Olabisi Onabanjo University with a Bachelor of Sciences degree in Pharmacology and Therapeutics, leaving with a distinct passion for technological advancements, critical thinking, clinical innovations and drug therapy.

leadership_team.name: Likali Samuel Kolo
